#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 10;
const int INF = 1e9;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, rev;
    Edge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), capacity(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
vector<int> level, ptr;

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
    graph[u].emplace_back(v, cap, graph[v].size());
    graph[v].emplace_back(u, 0, graph[u].size() - 1);
}

bool bfs(int src, int dst) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(src);
    level[src] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const Edge& e : graph[u]) {
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[dst] != -1;
}

int dfs(int u, int dst, int flow) {
    if (u == dst || flow == 0) return flow;
    for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = graph[u][i];
        if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dfs(e.to, dst, min(flow, e.capacity));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.capacity -= pushed;
                graph[e.to][e.rev].capacity += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maxFlow(int src, int dst) {
    int total = 0;
    while (bfs(src, dst)) {
        fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
        while (int pushed = dfs(src, dst, INF)) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

int n, t;
char grid[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int scientists[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int capsules[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int distToInfected[MAX_N][MAX_N];

const int dRow[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
const int dCol[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

void computeInfectedDistances(int srcX, int srcY) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            distToInfected[i][j] = INF;
    
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    distToInfected[srcX][srcY] = 0;
    q.push({srcX, srcY});
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dRow[k], ny = y + dCol[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Y' && distToInfected[nx][ny] == INF) {
                distToInfected[nx][ny] = distToInfected[x][y] + 1;
                q.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> grid[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> scientists[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> capsules[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // Find reactor position (the one that will explode)
    int srcX = -1, srcY = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                srcX = i;
                srcY = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (srcX != -1) break;
    }
    
    if (srcX == -1) {
        // No reactor found, assume top-left is reactor
        srcX = 0; srcY = 0;
    }
    
    computeInfectedDistances(srcX, srcY);
    
    // Build flow network
    int totalNodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
    int source = totalNodes - 2;
    int sink = totalNodes - 1;
    
    graph.resize(totalNodes);
    level.resize(totalNodes);
    ptr.resize(totalNodes);
    
    // Connect source to each lab with scientists
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y' && scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                addEdge(source, encode(i, j, n), scientists[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect each lab to sink with capacity = capsules
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                addEdge(encode(i, j, n) + n * n, sink, capsules[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect labs that can be reached in time
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                // Lab can be used if distToInfected[i][j] > t (not infected by time t)
                // But scientists can escape if they reach a lab before it gets infected
                // A scientist at (i,j) can reach (x,y) if dist((i,j),(x,y)) < distToInfected[x][y]
                // We model this by connecting labs that are reachable in time
                
                // For each lab, connect to adjacent labs if reachable
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int ni = i + dRow[k], nj = j + dCol[k];
                    if (ni >= 0 && nj >= 0 && ni < n && nj < n && grid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        // Can move from (i,j) to (ni,nj) if we arrive before infection
                        // We'll handle this by connecting with infinite capacity
                        addEdge(encode(i, j, n) + n * n, encode(ni, nj, n), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Also connect labs to themselves for immediate capsule use
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                addEdge(encode(i, j, n), encode(i, j, n) + n * n, INF);
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxFlow(source, sink) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

int encode(int x, int y, int size) {
    return x * size + y;
}
